message.reasoning_content: We need to identify crimes based on facts: multiple credit card applications, malicious overdraft, failure to repay, false address, etc. In Chinese criminal law, this is "信用卡诈骗罪" (Credit Card Fraud) under Article 196 of Criminal Law. Also possibly "非法获取信用卡信息罪"? But here he applied for cards himself, then used them with no repayment ability, i.e., fraudulent use of credit cards. The crime is "信用卡诈骗罪". Could also be "诈骗罪" (fraud) but specific is credit card fraud. Also "伪造、变造金融票据罪"? No. He didn't forge cards. So single crime: credit card fraud. Also maybe "非法占有罪"? No. So answer: [罪名]信用卡诈骗罪<eoa>
